name: modsearch
description: Find a module by what you mean. Local semantic search over the module fleet (or any docs you send): a small CPU sentence encoder (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) fused with BM25, vectors cached on disk. No key, no cloud, no LLM call; degrades to BM25 alone if the encoder can't load. Powers the build hub's agent search.

search.docs: GET ?q=&k= ranks this box's fleet; POST {query, docs:[{id,text,name?}], k} ranks the docs you send -> {mode, results:[{id,score,sem,lex,why}]}
